memories.title: Episode 1: Initial Architecture Kickoff
memories.content:
Kickoff meeting for Project Hyperion. We decided to build a monolithic REST API using PostgreSQL for persistence and Redis for session and response caching.

---
[Supporting data]
- Episode Source: slack_sync
- Episode UUID: ep-101

memories.title: Episode 2: Protocol Scaling & Cache Race Issues
memories.content:
P99 latency spiked past 600ms on REST endpoints under peak load. We approved ADR-014: migrating all inter-service communications to gRPC with protobuf schemas. Furthermore, Redis cache showed split-brain race conditions under cluster failover; decided to deprecate Redis in favor of an In-Memory Raft-synchronized cache layer.

---
[Supporting data]
- Episode Source: meeting_transcript
- Episode UUID: ep-102

memories.title: Episode 3: Multi-Region Compliance & Active-Active DB
memories.content:
EU GDPR and latency requirements mandate multi-region active-active writes. PostgreSQL single-primary topology cannot satisfy this SLA. We officially invalidated the PostgreSQL architecture and migrated the primary transactional datastore to CockroachDB. Established strict team preference: all new microservices must enforce mutual TLS (mTLS).

---
[Supporting data]
- Episode Source: architecture_review
- Episode UUID: ep-103

memories.title: Episode 4: Production Launch Readiness
memories.content:
Final pre-production sprint. Commitment made: complete comprehensive chaos engineering and load testing by Friday at 5 PM. Verified that gRPC endpoints achieve p95 latency of 38ms. The team prefers Prometheus and Grafana for all observability dashboards.

---

- Episode UUID: ep-104
